input.title: BUG: required initialization imports are deferred by global lazy imports
input.body:
With CPython's global lazy imports enabled, importing pandas._libs can leave the datetime/parser C API capsules unpublished and pandas configuration options unregistered. The modules registering them are imported only for their side effects, so those imports can be deferred before a dependent use.

Reproducer (save as repro.py and run python -X lazy_imports=all repro.py):

```python
import importlib
import pandas as pd

importlib.import_module('pandas._libs')
assert type(pd._pandas_datetime_CAPI).__name__ == 'PyCapsule'
assert type(pd._pandas_parser_CAPI).__name__ == 'PyCapsule'
assert isinstance(pd.get_option('display.max_rows'), int)
```

Expected: both capsules and the option are initialized. Actual: the all-mode subprocess fails; the normal-mode subprocess passes. Explicit __import__ calls for pandas.core.config_init, pandas._libs.pandas_parser and pandas._libs.pandas_datetime make both modes pass. Verified on CPython main 25883627946 (3.16), Windows x64 and Linux x86_64, with pandas main 3e40a817 plus the local initialization patch and NumPy 2.5.4.

Related: https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/159408. The native GC crash is a separate Cython issue addressed in https://github.com/cython/cython/pull/8059. This report concerns initialization only; it does not claim complete global lazy-import compatibility.
